verses.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੀ ਘਰੀਂ ਪਰਾਹੁਣਾ ਜਿਉ ਰਹਦਾ ਭੁਖਾ।
verses.translit_en: bahutee gharee(n) paraahunaa jiau rahadhaa bhukhaa|

en.bdb: A guest of many houses remains hungry.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਝਾ ਬਬੁ ਨ ਰੋਈਐ ਚਿਤਿ ਚਿੰਤ ਨ ਚੁਖਾ।
verses.translit_en: saa(n)jhaa bab na roieeaai chit chi(n)t na chukhaa|

en.bdb: On the loss of common father of many, scant are the weeping and mental anxieties.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਹਲੀ ਡੂਮੀ ਢਢ ਜਿਉ ਓਹੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਧੁਖਾ।
verses.translit_en: bahalee ddoomee ddadd jiau oh kisai na dhukhaa|

en.bdb: When many drummers strike a drum, no one is pleased with the discordant voices.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਣਿ ਵਣਿ ਕਾਉਂ ਨ ਸੋਹਈ ਕਿਉ ਮਾਣੈ ਸੁਖਾ।
verses.translit_en: van van kaau(n) na sohiee kiau maanai sukhaa|

en.bdb: How could a crow wandering from forest to forest be happy and honourable.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਬਹੁ ਮਿਤੀ ਵੇਸੁਆ ਤਨਿ ਵੇਦਨਿ ਦੁਖਾ।
verses.translit_en: jiau bahu mitee vesuaa tan vedhan dhukhaa|

en.bdb: As a prostitute's body suffers from having many lovers,

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਜਨਿ ਹੋਰਨਾ ਬਰਨੇ ਬੇਮੁਖਾ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit_en: vin gur poojan horanaa barane bemukhaa ||19||

en.bdb: Those who worship others than the Guru are unhappy in their apostasy.
